env BOLERO_MODULE=off

# If BOLERO_TMPDIR is relative, 'bolero build' should derive an absolute $WORK directory.
cd $WORK
mkdir tmp
env BOLERO_TMPDIR=tmp
bolero build -work a
stderr 'WORK='$WORK

# Similarly if TMP/TMPDIR is relative.
env BOLERO_TMPDIR=
env TMP=tmp    # Windows
env TMPDIR=tmp # Unix
bolero build -work a
stderr 'WORK='$WORK

-- a/a.go --
package a
